If that's the case, then I have the ideal training method for you!

Haa, haa!
Machitan can't just stop on a dime~!
Mmh~. We were so close, too~.

Cops team, this isn't getting us anywhere!
Switch to a different formation—

Indeed! I happened to be walking by
when I heard your voice! But let us return to the subject at hand!
—True enough! Machikane Tannhauser does tend to be a bit clumsy at times.

A little while after signing my contract with Machikane Tannhauser,
she gazed up at the sky and murmured something to herself.
Ohh! Madam Chairwoman?!

Between today's game of cops and robbers and Chairwoman Akikawa's glowing endorsement...
it was a day that truly made me look forward to her future.

...Well, she might be Miss "So Close", but she really delivers when it counts.
She's got this, right! Show 'em what you got, Tannhauser!

—Ah, no, that's not it!
It's not like I find your training boring or anything, Trainer!

Her tenacious escape lasted for tens of minutes. Her relentless spirit
seemed to touch the hearts of all the Umamusume participating.

By the way, captured robbers can be rescued by their fellow teammates.
So the cops can't let their guard down until the very end, y'see.

............
Well, let's just give it a shot! Ei-ei-oh!

I saw on TV yesterday that people sometimes do tag
or triathlons as part of their training!

Indeed! But that is entirely in the past! Your unwavering ambition
and composure may seem unassuming, but maintaining them is no small feat!
—Yes, Cops and Robbers!

*gasp* *pant* *gasp* *pant*...!
No waaaay~! Can't let you do that~! Please, give a girl a break~!
An opening! HYAAAH~~!

And so,
both sides began the game of cops and robbers full of spirit. However—

It's been almost 20 minutes already. If I were being chased for that long,
I'd probably feel completely cornered...
Yes!

Just as Chairwoman Akikawa said, Machikane Tannhauser may often fall short,
but there's always a sense that she's bound to accomplish something big one day.

Hee, haa, haa, haa,
U-Uwoooooh!
Ouch!!
So huge~! I had no idea a place like this existed!
She smacked her forehead against a tree and tumbled to the ground.

If even one robber evades capture until time runs out, the Robbers win!
If they're all caught, the Cops win!
Eeeek~! You found me way too fast~!

In other words, your future shines brightly! I, for one,
am eagerly looking forward to your upcoming success! That is all! Ha ha ha~!
Man~. I really want to try doing some fun training~.

Also, the winning team gets high-end parfaits as a reward~!
So let's give it all we've got!
Yeah—!

Madam Chairwoman~! I'm back-desu.
...Wait, "a bit clumsy"?
Without further ado, let me explain the rules first~!
That's just who Tannhauser is.

Man~, public order is really being maintained here...
So, who's left uncaptured—wait, only Tannhauser? Seriously?
Yup. Even back in the Junior Club, she'd suddenly feel sick right when it mattered most, or get a nosebleed before a race. Yeah, she's definitely a "so close" Umamusume.

Apparently it's open for training use.
It looks like we can run at full throttle here without any worries.
Ehehe. That really cheered me up. Whenever I'm feeling down, the Chairwoman sometimes talks to me like that, y'know.
The ideal training will build your cardiovascular endurance, decision-making, and mental fortitude—all while keeping it fun like a game!

Machitan!! Woohoo, she came this way!
You're awesome!!

...!
Over in that bush, it's Tannhauser-san! Everyone, move in!

Nah, but hey... you really worked hard out there.
You never gave up, just like always.

We'll capture them as fast as possible!
Cops team, let's give it everything we've got!

Gah?! Could it be, could it be... am I the only one left?! Eeek~!
What do I do, how can I save them?! Maybe I should circle around—
Haa, hee, haa!
Tannhauser-san, secured...!
Machitan-san right there, halt!

Oh, ohhh! Machitan is incredible, isn't she?!
Dashing this way and that, she's been running away non-stop!
All right, let's do our best, Robber team!

Machikane Tannhauser skillfully dodged her pursuers,
and just as she managed to reach the jail—

Rock, paper, scissors, split-up-pyoi!
Pyoi! ...Pyoi! ...PYOI!!

Muuu~~~! So frustrating, so frustrating, so frustrating!
I was right there~!

We're pursuing you in relay formation!
Your capture is only a matter of time, give it up!

Muu, that's so frustrating~. I was right there, too.
...I guess I really never can pull off a clean win.

Haa, haa! Scurrying around like that...!
Just give up already—!

And so, after Machikane Tannhauser put out a quick call,
ten Umamusume gathered—and headed out to an open field.

We'll split into 5 on the Cops team and 5 on the Robbers team.
There's a time limit, so the Robbers run while the Cops catch them!
